notes.title: Gash Release
notes.notes:
[h2]Launch![/h2]
Gash is finally released! Join my world of Gash where you defeat many bosses and many different kinds of enemies. I challenge everyone to beat the final boss! (I can't). This project felt like a year but in reality, it was like a few months. This was a fun project to make back in prototyping and I had other friends to help me out. I hope you can all enjoy the product I've delivered.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
As mentioned in my other post, Gash will be receiving updates that go as far as new maps, enemies, new playable characters, and more bosses. Maybe in the future, as I failed to promise, [i]multiplayer[/i] can have a possibility of being implemented. 

See you there!
